items.title: I've joined Anthropic
items.whyItMatters: Karpathy rejoining Anthropic shifts the talent map — worth tracking for anyone building on top of Claude or watching frontier research direction.

items.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
items.whyItMatters: Concrete data that structured output guardrails, not model size, are the leverage point for reliable agentic task completion — directly applicable to production agent pipelines.

items.title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
items.whyItMatters: First credible instance of a model doing original math research, not just solving existing problems — the bar for 'what AI can replace' just moved.

items.title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
items.whyItMatters: Supply-chain attack via the editor extension ecosystem — any shop running extensions with repo access should audit their allow-list immediately.

items.title: Learnings from 100K lines of Rust with AI (2025)
items.whyItMatters: Spec-driven development with AI at scale — the contract-first workflow described here maps well to how agentic coding assistants stay coherent over large codebases.
